OpenSharing is the secure data sharing platform in Databricks that lets you share data and AI assets with users outside your organization, regardless of whether they use Databricks. OpenSharing is also the basis for Databricks Marketplace, an open forum for exchanging data products, and Clean Rooms, a secure and privacy protecting environment where multiple parties can work together on sensitive enterprise data.
